prompt: As of August 2024, who was president of the United States the last time The Beach Boys topped the chart on the Billboard Hot 100?
answer: Ronald Reagan was president. The Beach Boys’ “Kokomo” reached No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 on November 5, 1988, during Reagan’s presidency.
